jobs.title: Full Stack AI Engineer / Travel the World
jobs.description:
A growing AI-focused consulting organization is seeking a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer to join its hybrid team in Chicago or Denver. This full-time opportunity offers the chance to build cutting-edge AI applications using modern technologies including LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph, Python, React, and cloud-native tooling. The company partners with major enterprise organizations to develop and deploy production-ready AI systems that solve meaningful business challenges.

This is not a traditional software engineering role. The organization is looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex business problems, influencing technical strategy, and working directly with customers. Successful candidates will help shape AI initiatives from ideation through deployment while collaborating with highly experienced engineers in a fast-growing environment. This position offers exposure to emerging AI technologies, direct client interaction, technical leadership opportunities, and a strong engineering culture centered around mentorship and continuous learning.

Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Full stack development background
Experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, or similar languages
Experience building or integrating AI/LLM-based systems
Knowledge of LangChain, LangGraph, RAG frameworks, or similar tools
Strong software architecture and system design skills
Client-facing or consulting experience
Experience working in Agile environments
Excellent communication skills

Desired Skills & Experience

Experience deploying AI agents into production
React or Next.js expertise
Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
TDD and pair programming experience
Technical leadership or mentoring experience
Enterprise software consulting background
Experience with observability and distributed systems

What You Will Be Doing

Tech Breakdown

40% AI Engineering & LLM Applications
30% Backend Engineering
20% Frontend Development
10% Architecture & Technical Leadership

Daily Responsibilities

80% Hands On Development
10% Technical Leadership & Mentoring
10% Client & Team Collaboration

The Offer

Competitive salary

You Will Receive The Following Benefits

Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
Paid Vacation
401(k)
Professional Development Opportunities
Flexible Work Environment

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis now and in the future.

Posted By:
Charles Deuter
